{{Top|leg}}
A '''power focus unit''' was a component of a [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]]. The unit regulated the power output of the weapon's energy bursts. Power focus units could be modified to increase the power of an weapon's discharge; [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] modified the quad laser cannons on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to produce higher energy bursts when firing the weapon.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
